text:
customer_zoe: hitting parsing failure in JSON mode when I expect numeric type. API returns amount as string "100" causing downstream validation to fail. Example below — can someone look?

Alex (Support): sorry about that — can you paste the request+response and your account id?

customer_zoe: account: acct_9XXXX, time: 2026-03-10T21:12:34Z, request-id: req_abc123

customer_zoe: request:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
 -d '{"model":"rwd-claude-1","mode":"json","prompt":"Produce invoice JSON","schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"amount":{"type":"number"}},"required":["amount"]}}'
```

customer_zoe: response (choice content):
```json
{"amount":"100"}
```

Alex (Support): thanks — that looks like a type mismatch (string vs number). Did this start after yesterday's update? Any latency or auth errors?

customer_zoe: started ~3pm UTC yesterday. No auth errors. Latency normal.

Maria (Eng): pinging infra logs for req_abc123. @deploy-bot did we push anything to json-mode parser around that time?

deploy-bot: deploy: redwood/json-parser v2.4.1 rolled at 2026-03-09T14:58:03Z (deployer: ops-release)

Maria (Eng): thanks. Can you repro locally with the exact prompt? Also include the full generated text (not only parsed output) — maybe model wrapped number in quotes.

customer_zoe: full model output:
```text
{"amount":"100","currency":"USD"}
```

Sam (Product): quick Q: is this causing billing or downstream crash for customer? priority from customer is app failure (they treat amount as number).

Alex (Support): they're seeing validation exceptions and UI crash. Marking P1 for support escalation.

Maria (Eng): initial hypothesis: parser v2.4.1 strictifies on JSON-mode to always return strings for atomic tokens? Odd. I'll triage. Steps I need: 1) raw model text for a failing run, 2) model name+version, 3) how you're invoking schema enforcement (SDK param?).

customer_zoe: model: open-llm-3b v1.2, SDK: python redwood==3.0.4 generate(..., mode="json", schema=...) ; attaching raw_text

customer_zoe: raw_text:
```json
{"amount":"100","currency":"USD"}
```

Maria (Eng): thanks. Repro instructions (I'll try):
1) run curl above
2) if response wraps numbers as strings, check parser logs for tokenization and postprocessing

Maria (Eng): immediate mitigation options: 1) support can advise customer to coerce numeric strings to numbers client-side; 2) server-side hotfix: accept numeric strings and cast in JSON mode to expected numeric types when schema declares number; or 3) rollback json-parser to v2.4.0.

Alex (Support): advising customer to implement local cast as temporary workaround. Asking for ETA on hotfix.

Maria (Eng): assigning INF-342, I will try a patch to cast numeric strings -> numbers for number schema fields and run internal tests. If patch risky, fallback to rollback. I'll update within 4 hours.

Sam (Product): notify customers who might be affected via status page once we confirm blast radius.

Alex (Support): noted. Zoe — will loop back after eng update. :thumbsup:

customer_zoe: thanks — appreciate quick help :pray:
